verses.text: Around that time, John the Baptizer showed up preaching in Judea’s wilderness. His message was:
This is the one Isaiah the prophet was talking about: “A voice shouting in the wilderness: ‘Get the Lord’s road ready; make his paths straight!’”
John wore camel-hair clothes, with a leather belt around his waist. His food? Locusts and wild honey. That’s the menu. 🦗🍯
People came out to him from Jerusalem, all Judea, and the whole region around the Jordan.
They were baptized by John in the Jordan as they confessed their sins.
But when John saw many Pharisees and Sadducees coming for baptism, he said, “You brood of snakes! Who warned you to run from the coming wrath? 🐍
Then show fruit that proves you’ve repented!
Don’t tell yourselves, ‘Abraham is our father.’ I’m telling you: God can raise children for Abraham from these stones.
The ax is already at the roots of the trees. Every tree that produces no good fruit will be chopped down and thrown into the fire. 🪓🔥
“I baptize you in water for repentance. But the one coming after me is stronger than I am. I’m not even worthy to carry his sandals. He will baptize you in the Holy Spirit.
His winnowing fork is in his hand. He will thoroughly clear his threshing floor, gather the wheat into his barn, and burn the chaff with fire that can’t be put out.”
Then Jesus came from Galilee to the Jordan, to John, to be baptized by him.
John tried to stop him, saying, “I’m the one who needs to be baptized by you, and you’re coming to me?”
Jesus answered him, “Let it happen for now. This is the right way for us to fulfill all righteousness.” Then John let him.
As soon as Jesus was baptized, he came straight up out of the water. Then the heavens opened, and he saw God’s Spirit coming down like a dove and resting on him. 🕊️
A voice from heaven said, “This is my dearly loved Son. I’m so pleased with him.”
